articles.title: ON THE ROAD | In uMkhanyakude: Children wash, cows drink. And taps in KwaShukela remain dry
articles.description: The MK Party says fielding izinduna and traditional leaders as councillor candidates will restore accountability in rural municipalities. But in uMkhanyakude – where a R151 million water scheme collapsed, and taps have run dry for years beside a full dam – residents are asking a more basic question: who will bring the water?
